result.conclusion:
The task requires implementing two functions (Clamp and IsEven) with unit tests. All requirements are satisfied:

1. Clamp(value, minimum, maximum int) int - implemented correctly with the three specified behaviors (return minimum when below range, maximum when above range, value otherwise)

2. IsEven(value int) bool - implemented correctly using modulo 2, which properly handles negative values and zero as required

3. Unit test coverage - TestClamp covers all three boundary cases (below, within, above range); TestIsEven tests negative odd (-3), negative even (-2), zero (0), positive odd (3), and positive even (4)

The public_check.json shows tests passed with exit code 0 in the isolated verification environment. The implementation matches the specification and the tests provide adequate coverage of the required behavior.
